obligations.statement: Parent values remain declaratively owned until form hydration, or an imperative write waits for actual readiness.
obligations.event_relation: config-with-initial-values-applied -> form-ready-published -> values-hydrated, or form-ready-published -> imperative-values-written
obligations.failure_if_violated: Fresh open raises an early-write error while reused open appears correct.
required_concepts: declarative hydration or actual readiness signal

obligations.statement: The unrequested AuditEditor retains its remote configuration ownership.
obligations.failure_if_violated: A broad migration changes behavior outside the authorized RecordEditor scope.
